comparisons.name: pressed-increment-light
comparisons.description: The upper half while the mouse is held down on it in the key window: it takes the accent bezel and a white chevron; the lower half is unchanged. Aqua.

pixels.note: middle stop #3d88fd of the measured blue default-button gradient, at 2x read 2.5% below it on the way to #1c76ff: the half is 10 pt of gradient from y 9 to 19. That a pressed half takes it is inferred (spec: stepper, States)
left arm of the upper chevron: white on the accent (--mac-color-control-text-on-accent); inferred
fill of the lower half, unchanged (spec: Fill, measured)

comparisons.name: pressed-increment-dark
comparisons.description: The upper half while pressed in the key window, Dark Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured blue default-button gradient, dark, just below its middle stop #1764db, on the way to #1561d3; inferred as above
fill of the lower half, unchanged: white at 25% over the #2f3032 window background (spec measures #686869 over #363637)

comparisons.name: pressed-decrement-light
comparisons.description: The lower half while pressed in the key window; the upper half is unchanged. Aqua.

pixels.note: the measured blue default-button gradient 2.5% (at 2x) to 5% (at 1x) below its middle stop #3d88fd, on the way to #1c76ff: the half is 10 pt of gradient from y 19 to 29; inferred as above
fill of the upper half, unchanged (spec: Fill, measured)

fill of the upper half, unchanged: white at 25% over the #2f3032 window background (spec measures #686869 over #363637)
